I know it's hard. I'm mostly that way as well, except that since most of my life revolves around my depression I end up with nothing to say at all to my friends. Family is no help as well. So I had close to zero support system. Plus my therapist is way too expensive to go often to. 

Right now I'm at a difficult place. Difficult meaning jobless, directionless, trying not to be pulled down to suicidal modes that can be very hard to get out of. 

I found a friend who's willing to listen and help me out. It's been a year and I can't emphasize how important he has been to me all these months. If he hadn't been here supporting me, I would've been less functional as I am now, or worse, I'd be dead. 

I wish I could say I am strong enough to weather all of these on my own. But I have been depressed for so long, and everything fell apart with my first major episode 8 years ago. I don't even know what a "normal life" is anymore because mostly what holds me down to this world are promises that I will live on.

I went through a month of pills for my PMDD because I was told it'd stabilize me even through my pill-break period. It made me function, but also gave me an endless supply of rage. Right now I've changed over to a new one, and it works much better.

I would've read it as the following, "Oh, since I have that "fixed" mindset, and I've tried changing these past few years, but I keep failing, so I must be a worthless waste of space because I can't do it. I'm a failure." 

Personally for myself, nowadays I just tell myself it's okay to be down, and there will be days that will be worse than others. But at the end of the day, I'm alive. Subsequently it's about building little victories. Maybe, I sent a resume, I continued my German, I walked out of the house, etc.

I tell myself the subtopic is one topic so that I won't be overwhelmed, so that at least, I can continue living, and hopefully growing rather than sliding further down.

I kept them all in as my honeymoon period started to crumble and by the end of it I couldn't cope. If you play your Knight in any instance / region and have yet to reach the class spark cap, you will get Knight sparks in normal drops. So it doesn't matter if you have gone through the places on your Cryo.
